tagline.en: The road to northern Manitoba: up the Interlake between the big lakes, past the Grand Rapids dam and through the boreal forest to Thompson
tagline.zh: 通往曼尼托巴北部的道路：沿两大湖之间的湖间地区北上，经大急流水坝，穿过北方森林抵达汤普森

start.en: The Perimeter Highway (PTH 101) on the north-west edge of Winnipeg
start.zh: 温尼伯西北边缘的环城公路（101 号省级干线公路）

end.en: Thompson, the nickel-mining city that is the hub of northern Manitoba
end.zh: 汤普森，以镍矿起家、为曼尼托巴北部中心的城市

en: Highway 6 is the main road from southern Manitoba to Thompson and the north. It leaves Winnipeg north-west across farmland, runs up the Interlake between Lake Manitoba and Lake Winnipeg past Lundar, Eriksdale and Gypsumville, and then enters a long stretch of forest and muskeg with very few settlements.

At Grand Rapids it crosses the Saskatchewan River where it enters Lake Winnipeg, beside Manitoba Hydro's dam. North of there it passes the junction at Ponton, where Highway 39 leads west towards Flin Flon, and continues to Thompson.

For much of its length it is a two-lane road carrying the freight of the north: fuel, groceries, mining supplies and, from Thompson, the nickel that has been trucked south, among other places to the Royal Canadian Mint in Winnipeg.
zh: 6 号公路是从曼尼托巴南部通往汤普森及北部地区的主干道路。它自温尼伯向西北穿过农田，沿曼尼托巴湖与温尼伯湖之间的湖间地区北上，经伦达、埃里克斯代尔与吉普瑟姆维尔，随后进入一段漫长的森林与泥炭沼泽地带，沿途聚落极少。
在大急流，它在萨斯喀彻温河注入温尼伯湖之处过河，旁边就是曼尼托巴水电公司的水坝。再往北，它经过庞顿路口——39 号公路由此西通弗林弗伦方向——继续前往汤普森。
全线大部分为双车道，承担着北方的货运：燃油、食品、矿山物资，以及从汤普森南运的镍，其去处之一是位于温尼伯的加拿大皇家铸币厂。

en: The route out of Winnipeg up the Interlake has carried the number 6 since 1947. For years it ended in the Interlake; the northern extension was driven by two projects of the 1960s, the nickel mine and new city at Thompson and the hydroelectric dam at Grand Rapids.

A road, Provincial Road 391, was opened to Thompson in 1964. Highway 6 was extended from Gypsumville to Grand Rapids in 1964, supporting the dam, and then north to Ponton under the Schreyer government. Sources disagree on the date: the Thompson Citizen, quoting the area's MLA, puts completion in late 1971, while English Wikipedia gives 1972. In 1987 the Ponton–Thompson road, until then PR 391, was made part of Highway 6.
Recent work has concentrated at the southern end, where the province twinned the highway from the Perimeter to Grosse Isle, and on resurfacing and rebuilding the long northern stretches.
zh: 自温尼伯沿湖间地区北上的这条路线自 1947 年起编为 6 号。多年来它止于湖间地区；向北延伸由 20 世纪 60 年代的两个项目推动：汤普森的镍矿与新城，以及大急流的水电站大坝。
1964 年，391 号省道通到汤普森。同年，6 号公路自吉普瑟姆维尔延伸至大急流，服务于大坝建设；随后在施赖尔政府任内继续北延至庞顿。各方对完工日期说法不一：《汤普森公民报》援引当地省议员称 1971 年底完工，英文维基百科则作 1972 年。1987 年，庞顿至汤普森段（此前为 391 号省道）并入 6 号公路。
近年的工程集中在南端——该省将环城公路至格罗斯岛段加宽为双幅——以及漫长北段的重铺与重建。

value.en: 739.8 km from the Manitoba Highway Inventory (2018); English Wikipedia gives 738.6 km.
value.zh: 据曼尼托巴公路清单（2018 年）为 739.8 公里；英文维基百科作 738.6 公里。

figures.source: Manitoba Infrastructure, Highway Inventory 2018 (computed); English Wikipedia, Manitoba Highway 6

why.en: No figure found for the original road or the 1960s–70s extensions. Later spending is announced in programmes: a five-year plan from 2013 of $125 million on the southern part and $63 million on the northern part, and in 2023 more than $100 million for the highway, including $40 million to twin it from the Perimeter to Grosse Isle.
why.zh: 未查到原始道路及 20 世纪 60—70 年代延伸段的造价。此后的开支以计划形式公布：2013 年起的五年计划中南段 1.25 亿加元、北段 6,300 万加元；2023 年为该路拨款逾 1 亿加元，其中 4,000 万加元用于环城公路至格罗斯岛段加宽为双幅。

value.en: The province, through Manitoba Infrastructure and its successor, Manitoba Transportation and Infrastructure.
value.zh: 省政府，经由曼尼托巴基础设施厅及其后继机构曼尼托巴交通与基础设施厅。

figures.source: Government of Manitoba news releases, 5 December 2013 and 2023

value.en: Completed in late 1971 according to the Thompson Citizen, quoting the area's MLA; 1972 in English Wikipedia, Manitoba Highway 6.
value.zh: 据《汤普森公民报》援引当地省议员，1971 年底完工；英文维基百科“曼尼托巴 6 号公路”条目作 1972 年。

figures.source: Thompson Citizen; English Wikipedia, Manitoba Highway 6

timeline.en: The Interlake route out of Winnipeg is numbered 6.
timeline.zh: 自温尼伯出发的湖间地区路线编为 6 号。

timeline.en: Highway 6 reaches Grand Rapids; Provincial Road 391 reaches Thompson.
timeline.zh: 6 号公路通到大急流；391 号省道通到汤普森。

timeline.en: The extension from Grand Rapids to Ponton is in service (late 1971 by one account).
timeline.zh: 大急流至庞顿延伸段投入使用（另一说为 1971 年底）。

timeline.en: The Ponton–Thompson road, formerly PR 391, becomes part of Highway 6.
timeline.zh: 庞顿至汤普森段（原 391 号省道）并入 6 号公路。

timeline.en: The province announces a five-year plan for the highway, $125 million south and $63 million north.
timeline.zh: 该省公布该路五年计划，南段 1.25 亿加元、北段 6,300 万加元。

timeline.en: More than $100 million is announced for the highway, including twinning from the Perimeter to Grosse Isle.
timeline.zh: 该省宣布为该路拨款逾 1 亿加元，包括环城公路至格罗斯岛段加宽为双幅。
